title: Minimum material for a closed cylinder · Set 2
statement:
A closed cylinder has volume $2\pi([$a])^3$. Find the radius minimizing its surface area.

[__________]{a}
hints: Include two caps plus the side.
Solve the derivative equation for positive $r$.
solution: $S(r)=2\pi r^2+4\pi([$a])^3/r$. Its derivative has sign of $r^3-([$a])^3$, so it switches from negative to positive at $r=[$a]$.
